body: What can one engineer build when a project looks like it needs a whole team? At Revolut, an engineer used Codex to build an internal code review service himself. Its designers used Codex to turn seven years of design documentation into a format AI could read in a single day. OpenAI also helps Revolut’s financial crime team investigate flagged payments and respond faster to make shopping safer. Read the full story: https://openai.com/business/customer-stories/revolut/
